design: One changed-input test process, saved scientific outputs, separate plot render from saved data, independent source/theory and code/result review

measurement.contract_path_resolution: Resolved to the actual unchanged runner before execution; duplicate implementation_validation_cap is its existing field vocabulary and equals test_allocation
measurement.source_preparation_and_network: outside test/plot envelope, actual measured or UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO

numerical_acceptance.reference: independently composed Decimal80 formulas from native string literals and exact SI constants
numerical_acceptance.source_rows: exact printed literals and row/level IDs
numerical_acceptance.physical_accuracy: source precision, method and covariance not certified by these tolerances

required_controls: raw source 52/368/171/25/4275 structure; selected states and 19-state collision support; source last3005 retained
all native rate cells finite/nonnegative with original labels and distinct radiative section
energy and rate unit conversion against Decimal80; detect missing100 or1e-6
native selection rejects1000, nonnative, outside support, unqualified3005 and bool/nonfinite T
derived upward pair against Decimal80 at the24native supported T for selected2->1 edge
explicit thermal reciprocity argument required; absence does not infer a distribution
population-derived internal energy plus aggregate material kinetic compensation cancels
common composition energy-reference offset cancels analytically and in independent reference
zero-density controls; nonnegative finite density validation
representation overflow and nonzero-underflow explicit handling
positive-flux entropy/free-energy sign; zero-density logarithm diagnostic qualified
no species heat/momentum/stress, no automatic thermal pool, no independent binding RHS
A21 remains independent radiation metadata and emits no photon on a collisional event
Bennett2008 selected by explicit source version;27rows,50..10000K,1000/3000 correctedvalues;2003history retained and never additive
no physical DCS/state-mass/RAbranch/covariance admission from source or fit metadata

saved_controls.native_HD_points: 24 supported selected-edge T values: native down, derived up, equilibrium ratio
saved_controls.selected_population_examples: T1005K, nHplus=1e6m^-3, nlower=2e6m^-3; upper=0,0.5*equilibrium,1*equilibrium,2*equilibrium; synthetic consumer examples
saved_controls.LiH_plot: 27 original2003 and corrected2008 printed rows only; no fit evaluation

panels: native HD down and derived up at accepted points;3005 retained as out-of-contract native point
plot_contract.readback: Root must view PNG and record axis/unit/source/support interpretation
plot_contract.adversarial_controls: unit-factor, missing-weight and energy-sign controls in tests; do not run more science during plotting

stop_rule: After one measured PASS and independent scoped review, stop optional tests. A concrete failure permits one diagnosed repair within the same allocation. No unchanged prior suite, global IVP, fit, or broad scan.
historical_budgets: No reset, transfer or HE101/PHYS91 reserve use
